reconcileDrift: ProductionScreenDataManager can persist correction fields and call undoLastTransition only when given a prebuilt list, but the domain currently exposes no public deterministic operation to rebuild dependent future actions after arbitrary correction or undo. Existing transition rescheduling logic is private, so AC-032/039 cannot be integrated without duplicating scheduling in data code.
goal: Provide a pure deterministic domain-owned action rebuild/correction API used by arbitrary batch corrections and undo. Preserve completed/skipped history, stable logical action IDs where the obligation survives, elapsed-vs-civil semantics, user-fixed dates with explicit conflicts, and idempotence; remove the need for callers to invent a rebuilt list.
acceptanceCriteria: A typed correction operation recalculates only dependent pending future actions from actual/corrected anchors while preserving past events and terminal history.
User-fixed due moments remain unchanged and emit explicit ScheduleConflict consequences.
Undo derives its rebuilt action list in domain code, removes only the latest transition, restores state/placement, and returns obsolete action IDs for reminder cancellation.
Logical action IDs are stable for surviving obligations and repeated rebuild/undo input is deterministic and duplicate-free.
Elapsed soak targets and civil-time daily actions retain their distinct time-zone semantics.
Scenario-named tests cover AC-032 and AC-039 edge cases and idempotence.
No data, Compose, platform, ledger or product-scope changes; specialist does not run Gradle.
